technical.summary: EQT shows solid trend structure with EMA golden cross and price above all major MAs, but momentum indicators are overbought and MACD histogram remains negative, creating a mixed signal suitable for cautious entry on pullback rather than immediate aggressive positioning.

fundamental.summary: EQT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 71 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but no congressional conviction and stale trading data (3+ years old) limit conviction; neutral AAII sentiment suggests mixed positioning.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (396.64), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring energy multinationals, with earnings event 71 days out adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA golden cross with price above all major moving averages and supertrend bullish creates solid trend structure; extreme fear sentiment (10/100) offers contrarian buy opportunity at support level (36.6107).
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis at 396.64, flat yield curve, rising dollar), overbought momentum (stochRSI, Williams %R), negative MACD histogram, weak fundamentals (no insider/institutional support, high earnings risk in 71 days), and price not above 200-EMA undermine conviction.

decision.entry_rationale: EMA golden cross and price above major moving averages provide solid trend structure, and extreme fear sentiment (10/100) offers contrarian opportunity at support. However, severe macro headwinds, overbought momentum, and weak fundamentals warrant waiting for pullback confirmation before entry.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis (396.64) and flat yield curve signal recession risk; earnings binary event in 71 days combined with negative MACD and weak institutional support create elevated downside risk.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical bullish but fundamental, sentiment, and risk agents strongly bearish; debate winner is bear with high confidence.
decision.portfolio_note: Already 30 positions in Energy sector; adding EQT would increase concentration risk in high-volatility sector during macro stress—recommend deferring until macro clarity or sector rotation.
